class.name: Cabin3D
class.brief_description: The root of a driver's cab.
class.description: The interior of one [VehicleServer] cabin ([method set_cabin]). It knows one thing about the vehicle it sits in: its handle. Every read and every manipulation below it goes through [code]CabinSystem[/code], and the elements hold no path to a controller at all - the handle is handed down to them from here. Native because of the shake: a fixed-step spring integration ([code]TDynamicObject::update_shake[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:8048-8136[/code]) running every frame in every occupied cab.

method.name: get_cabin
method.description: The [VehicleServer] cabin this interior is of - set by whoever builds it; its vehicle comes with it.

method.name: get_camera_shake_offset
method.description: How far the shake has moved the driver's head.

method.name: get_camera_shake_roll
method.description: How far the shake has rolled the driver's head [rad].

method.name: get_camera_transform
method.description: Where the driver's head is: the cab's transform moved to the driver's position.

method.name: get_sound_listener_context
method.description: Which soundproofing of the cab the listener hears through - the original's [code]CabOccupied + 1[/code] ([code]sound.cpp:981-1008[/code]): 0 the rear cab, 1 the machine room, 2 the front cab, 3 an open window.

method.name: get_vehicle_rid
method.description: The vehicle this cab sits in - the vehicle of its cabin ([method set_cabin]).

method.name: is_cabin_ready
method.description: Whether the cab is ready ([signal cabin_ready] was emitted).

method.name: set_cabin
method.description: The [VehicleServer] cabin this interior is of. Its vehicle comes with it ([method VehicleServer.cabin_get_vehicle]): when that changes, [signal vehicle_rid_changed] is emitted before [signal cabin_changed].

signal.name: cabin_changed
signal.description: The interior is of another cabin of its vehicle now, [param cabin].

signal.name: cabin_ready
signal.description: The cab is ready - it entered the tree for the first time.

signal.name: camera_configuration_changed
signal.description: The cab's driver position and camera bounds were rebuilt.

signal.name: vehicle_rid_changed
signal.description: The cab now sits in another vehicle, [param vehicle_rid] - the vehicle of the cabin it was given. A subclass reacts to this rather than overriding the cabin's setter.
